purpose: The 2026-10-08 G1/G2 plan's WP-1A-A0-003 (tenant context runtime and API envelope, PLF-001) is the platform-kernel's first code (MOD-000, owner A0, register §4.2). RFC-2026-029 §7 allows code, fakes and consumer tests against CTR-TEN/API/ERR/IDM, all Candidate, as reversible work under RFC-2026-034 §2.1. This package writes that code as pure TypeScript under src/modules/platform-kernel/: a resolver that derives a trusted CTR-TEN-001 context from an authenticated principal and an untrusted scope selection through a directory port, the CTR-API-001 envelope builders, CTR-ERR-001 stable errors that carry no internal detail, and the CTR-IDM-001 replay/conflict outcome, each checked against the catalog's own fixtures. Its first pull request (PR-G) only opens the package: this manifest, src/** in tsconfig.json's include so `npm run typecheck` reads the code, and the branch row. The provider-bound increment (Supabase session, supabase-js with the user's JWT, §8/7 cookies, the real directory adapter, composition wiring) is a later increment of this same package, brought in by an amendment of this manifest; until it lands this package does not meet the plan row's acceptance (open_blockers, C0-259-3).

acceptance_criteria: PR-G: `npm run typecheck` includes src/**/*.ts and src/**/*.tsx and still passes with no src/ directory; test-kits/app-stack.test.mjs's tsconfig pins pass; the branch resolves to WP-1A-A0-003 alone; npm run check is green.

Each checker (tenant context, stable error, envelope, idempotency record) accepts every valid fixture and rejects every invalid fixture its contract manifest lists, and the listed fixtures equal the files in examples/; pinned constants (reference bounds, the private-reference pattern, the API version) equal the schemas' values.

The resolver refuses a missing principal (auth), a client-supplied actor, locale, timezone or id, a page without a business, and a scope the directory does not admit; a member of one workspace selecting another gets an error byte-identical to the one for a nonexistent workspace; a failing directory yields a temporary error with nothing copied from the failure.

A context not minted by the resolver (an `as` cast, a JSON round trip) is refused by the envelope builders; envelope request and correlation ids equal the context's, and an error's correlation id equals the envelope's.
No stable error or envelope carries a thrown value's message, name or stack, and every error's details is empty (CTR-ERR-001's maxProperties 0).
The idempotency outcome gives replay, conflict (an ERR `conflict`) and independent per CTR-IDM-001, with the blake3 witness accepted and no hash algorithm pinned.

node scripts/verify-app-boundaries.mjs --require-parser passes over src/ (§6.3, no `any`, no @ts-ignore); `npm run test:app` runs the new tests in CI's application job; nothing under domain/ imports node:, a provider SDK, Next.js or React.

The pure-TypeScript increment returns a bare stable error from the resolver; the wire form needs a Candidate change by the contract's owner (A0), such as an optional tenant_context on error or a pre-tenant error shape. PR-2's runner carries the same gap: a refusal before a context exists is its RunResult `error` (the resolver's bare stable error), and a failure before any correlation id was minted is `uncorrelated`, carrying nothing; the composition increment maps both to the wire once this is answered.
